text.arabic_uthmani: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: purpose or result particle binding the opening test clause to the prior provision rather than beginning an independent assertion
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the ayah open in dependency. The first word sends the reader back to the prior provision and frames that abundance as purposeful testing, not as a fresh, detached topic. Its tiny attached shape carries a large clause relation: purpose, outcome, and boundary-crossing explanation are compressed before the ayah pivots to the conditional warning.

topics.headline: purpose tied to the prior provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by explaining the prior provision instead of opening a new independent warning.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the opening as a purpose-shaped subjunctive clause continued from the prior statement.

topics.headline: purpose and outcome converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that intended testing and realized exposure meet in the particle, while the local grammar still selects a governed purpose clause.
topics.reason: The broader purpose-result range is meaningful here, but it remains bound to the following subjunctive verb rather than becoming several independent senses.

topics.headline: small attached particle carries clause weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the disproportion between the particle's light surface and the heavy boundary relation it carries.
topics.reason: The particle is a proclitic governing the following verb and sequencing the purpose clause before the internal conditional turn.

words.gloss_range: we test, examine, or expose them through the prior provision; not a merely accidental temptation or independent indicative event
words.root_gloss_range: trial, testing, exposing, tempting, and assaying; local grammar selects purposeful examination through provision while assay pressure remains active as image
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْتِنَهُمْ}} ({{tr:naftina-hum}}) names the provision as a deliberate test. The subjunctive dependency keeps the action inside the purpose frame, while the attached plural object carries the prior recipients into the role of those being examined and keeps the medium distinct. The root {{ar:ف ت ن}} ({{tr:f-t-n}}) makes abundance feel like an assay medium: ease exposes response and places water-provision inside the wider pattern where worldly goods and pressures test response. Variant polarity and voice evidence mark the verb as a pressure point, but the local surface keeps the canonical reading as purposeful divine testing. Structurally, the ayah stages divine testing through provision before it turns to the conditional rule of consequence.

topics.headline: testing governed by purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that testing is stated as the intended end of provision, not as accidental prosperity.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the purpose particle and contains the plural object in the same compact verbal complex.

topics.headline: same recipients tested through the medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ones who received abundance become the tested object, while the medium of testing is kept distinct.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle separates the object suffix from the following prepositional complement and links both across the boundary.

topics.headline: abundance as assay image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the provision is not neutral ease; it functions like an assay that reveals what the recipients are made of.
topics.reason: The assay and inward-trial pressure survives as image, while the local construction selects testing through provision rather than every possible temptation branch.

topics.headline: variant exposes polarity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how much the clause depends on the test verb's polarity, while the canonical surface remains affirmative purpose.
topics.reason: The variant can be retained as apparatus showing interpretive pressure, but it does not replace the aligned local surface.

topics.headline: provision joins the wider test field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that water-provision is a concrete local member of the wider pattern where worldly goods and pressures test response.
topics.reason: The broader recurrence evidence is coherent because the local clause itself makes provision the testing medium.

topics.headline: testing precedes conditional law
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged movement from divine testing through provision to the later conditional rule of consequence.
topics.reason: The purpose clause is complete before the conditional begins, and the bundle tracks the discourse shift from first-person testing to later legal consequence.

words.gloss_range: in it, through it, or within that provision-situation; locally the pronoun most directly resumes the prior water while allowing the wider abundance setting
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) completes the test clause by bringing the prior provision back as the medium. The pronoun most directly resumes the water, yet the phrase also lets the whole abundance situation be the setting in which testing happens. The preposition keeps location and instrument together: they are tested inside the ease and by means of it.

topics.headline: water referent with wider situation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small suffix pulls the prior water into the verse, while the abundance situation remains in view.
topics.reason: The bundle marks the suffix as most directly resuming prior water, with a broader situation reading available but not dominant.

topics.headline: inside and by means of provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision is both the environment of the test and the means by which the test works.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is attached to the testing verb, so locative and instrumental pressures are locally licensed.

topics.headline: purpose clause closes before the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the purpose beat is complete before the ayah turns to the conditional warning.
topics.reason: The clause boundary places this word at the end of the opening purpose unit.

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating pivot from the completed test-purpose clause into an open conditional rule
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the internal hinge. It keeps the warning connected to the test by provision, but it also prevents the conditional from being swallowed into the purpose clause. The particle shifts scale from the plural recipients of abundance to any singular participant who turns away, so the ayah moves from explanation to rule in one light beat.

topics.headline: linked but distinct conditional frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conditional warning is linked to the test but opens a new grammatical frame.
topics.reason: The conjunction stands between a completed purpose clause and the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: light particle marks heavy turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how a minimal bound particle carries the ayah's major internal transition.
topics.reason: The particle is phonologically light but it initiates the conditional unit immediately.

topics.headline: plural test becomes individual rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scale shift from collective provision to the accountability of whoever turns away.
topics.reason: The following conditional particle changes the clause from plural-tested recipients to an open singular subject.

words.gloss_range: open conditional whoever, functioning as the singular subject of refusal and the resumed object of consequence
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) universalizes the warning without making it vague. It supplies the subject of the refusal and is resumed as the object of the consequence, so the same whoever acts and then undergoes the answer. The relative flavor identifies the type of person, while the conditional grammar makes the rule open to any participant rather than a named group; prior provision, lineage, or group status does not shield the one who turns away.

topics.headline: one particle governs refusal and consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same conditional subject controls both the act of turning away and the punishment that answers it.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the protasis and apodosis and is resumed by the later object suffix.

topics.headline: whoever scope excludes exemption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prior provision, lineage, or group identity cannot exempt someone from the condition.
topics.reason: The jussive conditional frame selects an open whoever rather than a closed named referent.

topics.headline: plural recipients become singular accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that collective testing does not dissolve individual accountability.
topics.reason: The clause shifts from a plural object in the testing clause to a singular generic conditional participant.

words.gloss_range: turns away or withdraws in aversion within a conditional protasis; the following separation preposition selects avoidance rather than presentation or objection
words.root_gloss_range: presentation, exposure, breadth, opposition, and turning aside; local Form IV with the separation complement selects deliberate aversion
words.prose: {{ar:يُعْرِضْ}} ({{tr:yuʿriḍ}}) makes the fault an enacted turn away, not simple ignorance. Its jussive form places the act inside the condition before consequence is named, and the following complement selects aversion from the root {{ar:ع ر ض}} ({{tr:ʿ-r-ḍ}}) range rather than presentation, encounter, or confrontation. The word also keeps a bodily image: the person gives the side where responsive attention is owed, and its tightened sound texture reinforces constricted avoidance. That refusal pattern echoes a consequence for turning from remembrance in 20:124, while this ayah intensifies the pattern into routed ascent-punishment.

topics.headline: Form IV withdrawal from the reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offense is directed withdrawal from the reminder, not vague neglect.
topics.reason: The following preposition and complement select the aversion branch of the root for the local verb.

topics.headline: refusal as condition trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that turning away is formulated as the legal trigger before any consequence is named.
topics.reason: The verb is apocopated under the conditional particle and forms the protasis whose answer follows.

topics.headline: avoidance rather than exposure or objection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between facing or encountering and the selected motion of evasive side-turning.
topics.reason: Other root-family possibilities sharpen the local sense by contrast, but the local Form IV frame selects aversion.

topics.headline: recognized refusal-reminder pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that turning from remembrance is a recognizable Quranic refusal pattern, here intensified by the routed-ascent consequence.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence with 20:124 is concrete and coherent, while local grammar still controls the local punishment image.

topics.headline: bodily side-turn with tightened sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices refusal as bodily reorientation, with the sound texture reinforcing constricted avoidance.
topics.reason: The rows tie the root image and local boundary contrast to the verb's embodied refusal.

words.gloss_range: separation preposition after the aversion verb, governing the full Lord-linked reminder phrase as the target abandoned
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) turns the refusal into distance. After the aversion verb, it selects separation rather than mere topic marking, and its scope reaches the whole Lord-linked reminder phrase. The fault is therefore not turning away in general; it is a chosen displacement from the address that should have remained active.

topics.headline: specific object of withdrawal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes the offense directional: away from a specific reminder, not simply away in general.
topics.reason: The preposition is governed by the aversion verb and governs the reminder noun as complement.

topics.headline: scope covers the Lord-linked phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that separation falls from the entire Lord-linked reminder relation, not from an isolated abstract memory.
topics.reason: The governed complement is the construct phrase, so the preposition's scope includes its genitive completion.

topics.headline: distance inserted between act and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that distance itself is made the grammatical shape of disobedience.
topics.reason: The particle mediates between the aversion verb and the reminder phrase, making separation explicit.

words.gloss_range: remembrance, reminder, mention, or revealed admonition as a governed verbal noun in construct with the Lord-title
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, reminding, admonishing, and revealed reminder; local construct keeps inward heed and communicated reminder together
words.prose: {{ar:ذِكْرِ}} ({{tr:dhikri}}) is the thing from which the subject turns away, but it is not bare memory. As a verbal noun in construct, it can hold remembrance of the Lord and the Lord's reminder together, so agency runs both toward human heed and toward divine address. The root {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) keeps inward heed, uttered mention, admonition, and revealed reminder in play, while local government makes this the precise object abandoned. It stands between aversion and the Lord-title, so the Lord is reached or rejected through the reminder, and the surah's earlier hearing of the message gives that reminder a concrete reception background.

topics.headline: remembrance of the Lord and the Lord's reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construct phrase can carry both human remembering and divine reminding without choosing only one agency route.
topics.reason: The verbal noun in construct licenses both subjective and objective construals of the genitive relation.

topics.headline: reminder as object of separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remembrance is made a grammatical object one can distance oneself from, not merely an inner state.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive verbal noun, making it the target of aversion.

topics.headline: memory, mention, admonition, and revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the abandoned object includes inward heed, uttered mention, and revealed address, while the local phrase keeps that range Lord-linked.
topics.reason: The broader root range survives because the local verbal noun and surah context support reminder and remembrance together, but it remains narrowed by the construct phrase.

topics.headline: reminder mediates relation to the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord is reached or rejected through the reminder placed between aversion and the Lord-title.
topics.reason: The construct phrase fuses reminder and lordship, and the word stands structurally between aversion and the genitive Lord-title.

topics.headline: heard message preserved as reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah's earlier hearing of the message gives this reminder a concrete reception background.
topics.reason: The same-surah hearing context supports reminder reception, while the local construct gives the phrase its immediate syntax.

words.gloss_range: his Lord, master, sustainer, and governing nurturer, possessed by the conditional subject within the reminder construct
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, mastery, nurture, formation, and governance; local possessed singular title personalizes sustaining authority
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِۦ}} ({{tr:rabbihi}}) makes the abandoned reminder personal. The suffix binds the conditional subject to his own Lord, and the root {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) brings sustaining mastery, nurture, and governance into the offense. The title turns prior provision into evidence of lordship: the one who is sustained turns away from the reminder of the very Lord who sustains him. It also seals the offense phrase before the punishment verb, turns repeated lordship language into personal accountability, and later contrasts with explicit invocation in 72:20; the compact sound of the construct supports the reminder-Lord bond.

topics.headline: suffix individualizes lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is universal but not impersonal: each whoever is bound to his own Lord.
topics.reason: The genitive possessed noun and suffix bind the title back to the conditional subject.

topics.headline: sustaining authority is what is refused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal is against sustaining authority, not against a remote or generic deity title.
topics.reason: The root field and selected title foreground nurture, mastery, and governance within the local possessed phrase.

topics.headline: local lordship thread becomes accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a broad lordship formula becomes personally accountable here and later contrasts with explicit invocation in 72:20.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah and formula evidence is concrete, and the local suffix turns the title into individual accountability.

topics.headline: lordship seals the offense phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition does not close until the Lord-linked relation is named.
topics.reason: This word completes the construct phrase immediately before the apodosis begins.

topics.headline: compressed sound binds reminder to Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the construct phrase as a compact relational unit, supported by repeated sound and the doubled center of the title.
topics.reason: The sound rows reinforce the already licensed construct relation without changing the lexical selection.

words.gloss_range: he routes, inserts, or threads him into the punishment as the conditional answer; the object is the one who turned away
words.root_gloss_range: entering, following a path, routing, threading, conduct, and insertion; local transitive frame selects imposed routing of a person into punishment
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْلُكْهُ}} ({{tr:yasluk-hu}}) flips the subject's agency. The one who turned away becomes the object built into the routing verb, and the jussive form answers the condition. The root {{ar:س ل ك}} ({{tr:s-l-k}}) makes punishment a forced path or constrained channel one is threaded through, not merely a destination, and the route image combines with the final ascent into an ordered movement from testing to refusal to imposed passage to arduous punishment. Variant readings expose person and causation pressure, but the local surface keeps a third-person legal answer with direct tactile insertion. The same marked routing root contrasts with other insertion scenes in 15:12, 26:200, and 72:27, while its directional sound pressure helps the uncommon verb carry the punishment mechanism.

topics.headline: the rejecter becomes the routed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency reversal: the one who acted in refusal is now acted upon as the inserted object.
topics.reason: The object suffix resumes the conditional participant, and the verb begins the apodosis.

topics.headline: punishment as constrained route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as a forced passage through a constrained channel rather than a static place.
topics.reason: The root's path and insertion pressure survives, while the local transitive frame makes the person the routed object rather than a voluntary traveler.

topics.headline: variant readings expose agency pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that person and causation are live pressure points, while the canonical wording keeps the consequence in third-person legal form.
topics.reason: The variants are useful apparatus for agency and causation, but they do not replace the aligned local Form I surface.

topics.headline: marked routing root across contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this marked routing root is used here for punitive insertion, contrasting with other insertion scenes such as 15:12, 26:200, and 72:27.
topics.reason: The concrete references preserve a real recurrence pattern while the local object and punishment phrase set this occurrence's function.

topics.headline: routing begins the consequence chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ordered movement from testing to refusal to imposed route to arduous punishment.
topics.reason: The apodosis starts with the routing verb before the punishment noun and qualifier.

topics.headline: rare route verb carries consequence load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an uncommon route verb, with directional sound pressure, bears the mechanism of punishment.
topics.reason: The distribution and sound rows reinforce the locally licensed route image.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite punishment, torment, or punitive domain into which the person is routed and which awaits the final ascent qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: punishment and torment alongside sweet or fresh-water valuation in the wider root field; local consequence selects punishment while allowing ironic water-linked inversion
words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابًا}} ({{tr:ʿadhāban}}) names the domain into which the rejecter is routed. Its indefinite accusative form leaves the punishment open in extent until the final qualifier defines its mode, so the final two indefinite accusatives sound and function as one paired consequence. The root {{ar:ع ذ ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-dh-b}}) selects punishment here, yet the wider sweet-water pressure matters because the ayah began from provision: refused refreshment returns as punitive condition. A common punishment noun is therefore sharpened by an unusual ascent qualifier and by its placement after rejected lordship, with a formula contrast to painful punishment in 2:10.

topics.headline: unbounded domain of insertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as an unbounded domain or condition into which the person is routed.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite noun follows the routing verb and functions as the punishment domain or specification.

topics.headline: punishment waits for its steep qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun does not complete the image until the final word defines its arduous quality.
topics.reason: The final accusative indefinite agrees with and qualifies the punishment noun.

topics.headline: sweet provision inverted into torment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a root field with sweet-water pressure appears here as punishment after water-provision has been refused as a test.
topics.reason: The local sense is punishment, but the prior water context lets the broader root pressure survive as controlled inversion rather than replacement.

topics.headline: common punishment noun made unusual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common punishment noun is sharpened by an unusual ascent qualifier and by its placement after rejected lordship.
topics.reason: The rows identify a concrete formula contrast with 2:10 and a local lordship-punishment relation.

topics.headline: paired indefinite cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final two indefinite accusatives sound and function as one paired consequence.
topics.reason: The matching indefinite accusative endings bind the noun and qualifier in the closing punishment phrase.

words.gloss_range: arduous ascent, steep severity, or exhausting upward strain functioning as the final qualifier of the punishment
words.root_gloss_range: ascending, climbing, rising, becoming difficult, and overburdening; local abstract qualifier selects steep hardship rather than honorable elevation
words.prose: {{ar:صَعَدًا}} ({{tr:ṣaʿadan}}) gives the punishment its final quality. As an indefinite accusative qualifier, it makes the punishment steep, arduous, and open-ended rather than a separate destination. The root {{ar:ص ع د}} ({{tr:ṣ-ʿ-d}}) turns ascent into bodily strain and punitive severity: this is not elevation as honor, but exhausting climb as torment. Variant vowelings can distribute the hardship into repeated climbs, while the canonical form compresses that pressure into one final quality. The close is marked by the burdened-ascent echo in 74:17, the opposite speech-ascent pole in 35:10, and a cadence that lands the ayah on open-ended steep severity.

topics.headline: ascent defines the punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ascent is the punishment's defining quality, not a second destination after punishment.
topics.reason: Agreement and attachment evidence lock the final word to the punishment noun as qualifier or qualitative specification.

topics.headline: climb becomes felt hardship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices vertical movement converted into bodily strain and punitive severity.
topics.reason: The root image of ascent survives, but the local punishment phrase selects hardship rather than neutral or honorable rising.

topics.headline: variant plurals distribute hardship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant vowelings can distribute the ascent into repeated climbs, while the canonical form compresses hardship into one quality.
topics.reason: The variants function as apparatus for the ascent image without governing the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: rare ascent field marks closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this rare ascent word as a marked close, with burdened-ascent texture from 74:17 and contrast with good speech ascending in 35:10.
topics.reason: The concrete references and rarity evidence support the payoff while local grammar keeps the word tied to the punishment noun.

topics.headline: final sound seals indefinite severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah landing acoustically and semantically on open-ended steep severity.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah and shares the final indefinite cadence with the punishment noun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ`: the purpose clause and its still-unspecified pronominal test medium.
baseline_models.mechanism: The assay branch makes testing a disclosure of quality, while the ordeal branch allows either ease or hardship to carry that test. Focus-only, the antecedent of `فِيهِ` remains open, but whatever fills it is not automatically a mark of approval.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or a person by trial supplies discrimination of quality, making `فِيهِ` a test medium rather than a reward label.
Ordeal through hardship or prosperity supplies the two-sided material that can test without itself deciding the outcome.

changed_reading.before: The clause says only that they are tested in some unspecified circumstance.
changed_reading.after: The circumstance denoted by `فِيهِ` functions as assay material: its apparent benefit or pain is distinct from what it reveals.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ`: a bodily turn away from a reminder tied to the subject's Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: Turning the side away is an enacted refusal of attention. Recall brings an absent matter back into operative presence, and nurture brings a charge toward completion; together they make the offense a break in formative orientation, not mere failure to retrieve information.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side away supplies the bodily geometry of refusing the reminder at the conditional threshold.
Bringing something back to mind after absence makes remembrance an active restoration of orientation.
Repair, nurture, and staged completion make the remembered relation formative rather than merely titular.

changed_reading.before: Turning from remembrance is a generic lapse of attention.
changed_reading.after: Turning away interrupts a continuing process by which the Lord's reminder reorients and forms the subject.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا`: causative entry into punishment qualified by arduous ascent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Insertion into something gives punishment a route-like interior. The arduous uphill branch adds gradient and continuing exertion, so the result is not a static penalty but compelled passage through worsening resistance.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to enter another thing supplies the enclosing transition into a punitive state.
Torment and severe inflicted pain identify the entered medium as punitive rather than neutral.
An arduous uphill pass supplies resistance, duration, and increasing effort to the punishment route.

changed_reading.before: The subject simply receives a severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: The subject is made to enter and continue through punishment as an arduous rising passage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from `نَفْتِنَهُمْ` to `يُعْرِضْ` and then `يَسْلُكْهُ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of trial is itself a deflecting pull from the right course, while the conditional subject then turns his own side away and is routed elsewhere. The focus can therefore stage an interaction between environmental inducement and accountable response rather than a detached examination.

activation_trace.role: Deflection from the right course supplies a lateral pull inside the test field.
Turning one's side away supplies the subject's enacted uptake of, or answer to, that lateral pull.
Passing along a path supplies the changed trajectory that follows the turn.

changed_reading.before: Testing observes a response from outside it.
changed_reading.after: The test field can exert a deflecting pull, while the person's own turn converts that pressure into a changed route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding condition aligns people on an extended way and supplies abundant water. The focus-purpose clause then turns that abundance from an uncomplicated endpoint into the material of an assay: provision tests what orientation persists inside plenty.

activation_trace.role: Assaying for quality supplies the discriminating function assigned to the preceding abundance.
Prosperity as ordeal permits copious provision itself, not only deprivation, to be the test medium.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the condition under which the provision is given.
An extended traversable route gives the straightness a concrete path structure that the later turn can abandon.
The act of furnishing drink supplies deliberate provision rather than accidental rainfall.
Water's emergence and abundance make the test medium materially copious.
Copious water and provision specify abundance as the salient antecedent carried into `فِيهِ`.

structural_cues: The purpose marker `لِـ` in 72:17 immediately follows the conditional provision in 72:16, and `فِيهِ` most naturally reaches back to that supplied abundance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies straight alignment, route, deliberate watering, copious water, and assay; I infer that abundance is the assay medium rather than the verdict. A live alternative is that `فِيهِ` points more broadly to the straight course or the whole condition, not water alone.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is rewarded with abundant water, after which an unrelated test is mentioned.
changed_reading.after: Abundant water is intentionally furnished as the test itself: plenty reveals whether straight orientation endures.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, receptive hearing becomes guidance and settled trust, after which diminution and oppressive burden are negated. The focus reverses that circuit: turning away from the reminder shuts down receptive reorientation and opens onto imposed burden.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side away supplies the inverse posture to receptive hearing.
Restoring something to mind supplies the signal that could renew orientation if received.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies active reception, not mere acoustic exposure.
Gentle indication toward the right path supplies the directional content received through hearing.
Settled security and trust supply the stabilized state produced by receptive guidance.
Diminution of a due or worth supplies one feared loss explicitly removed from the receptive path.
Burdensome imposition supplies the pressure negated after trust and reopened by the focus's opposite posture.

structural_cues: 72:13 gives the explicit sequence `لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ... آمَنَّا`, then uses a `فَمَن` conditional like the focus while negating loss and burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reception-to-trust sequence and its protected outcome; I infer that turning from remembrance is the inverse operation that breaks this circuit. The live alternative is that `ذِكْر` concerns ongoing recollection without depending on the earlier auditory sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts remembrance and punishment as isolated choices and outcomes.
changed_reading.after: It describes a reception circuit: understood guidance settles trust, while bodily refusal of the reminder reverses orientation and exposes the subject to burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first presents multiple cut-apart paths, then distinguishes surrender from deviation and active seeking of right direction. Assay in the focus can therefore be read as route discrimination: the test reveals which path a group inhabits, and the turn routes the refuser into the arduous one.

activation_trace.role: Assay that distinguishes quality supplies the sorting operation across divergent routes.
Passing through a path makes the disclosed difference consequential as an actual route.
The arduous uphill pass identifies one sorted route by its severe resistance.
Extended paths supply the route domain in which group differences become trajectories.
Cut-apart, divergent paths or groups supply plurality and separation before the focus's routing.
Handing over and releasing oneself supplies the responsive posture contrasted with deviation.
Deviation and leaning from right supplies the route divergence that anticipates turning away.
Straightness of path away from error supplies the sought route against which the arduous route is measured.

structural_cues: The plural `طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا` in 72:11 and the balanced `مِنَّا ... وَمِنَّا` in 72:14 frame differentiated groups; branchless `تَحَرَّوْا` adds deliberate seeking without an invented citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent paths, opposed group postures, seeking, assay, and routing; I infer that the test discloses and channels route identity. A live alternative is that these are separate moral descriptions without a single sorting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The test concerns individuals, followed by punishment for a separate act of refusal.
changed_reading.after: The test functions as route sorting among already differentiated paths, with refusal becoming entry into the resistant path.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior attempt at refuge explicitly increases engulfing pressure instead of removing it, and a later crowd becomes a layered mass. These cues activate a feedback reading of the focus: turning away seeks lateral shelter, but that substitute relation inserts the subject into a burden that accumulates and becomes harder to traverse.

activation_trace.role: Turning the side away supplies the departure that can redirect dependence toward another shelter.
Insertion into something supplies the enclosing consequence of the redirected dependence.
Arduous uphill pressure turns accumulation into a progressively harder passage.
Seeking refuge and protection supplies the attempted escape mechanism that fails.
Increase and growth supply the packet's explicit amplification rather than relief.
Engulfing and overpowering pressure supplies what the failed refuge increases.
A dense mass piled layer upon layer supplies the accretive shape of burden.

structural_cues: 72:6 grammatically links refuge to increased `رَهَق` with `فَزَادُوهُمْ`, while 72:19 places the layered mass `عَلَيْهِ`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed-refuge increase and a separate layered crowd; I infer a common accretive-pressure mechanism and connect the focus's turn to substitute refuge. The live alternative is that punishment is wholly imposed and neither context scene describes its internal dynamics.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is followed by an externally assigned difficult punishment.
changed_reading.after: Turning away can initiate a failed-refuge feedback loop in which substitute shelter compounds engulfing load until the route itself becomes arduous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same routing verb later places surveillance around an approved messenger, explicitly between his hands and behind him. That spatial reuse makes the focus's insertion into punishment one instance of managed emplacement: one route is guarded for transmission, while the other encloses refusal in arduous consequence.

activation_trace.role: Causing entry supplies the focus's managed placement into punishment.
Torment identifies the focus corridor by the pain it contains.
The arduous uphill pass gives that corridor resistant internal terrain.
The repeated act of inserting something into a spatial arrangement supplies a contrasting managed placement.
The interval between two sides supplies an interior zone for the later placement.
The fixed front-facing relation `between the hands` supplies the forward boundary of the guarded corridor.
Behind as the opposite of in front supplies the rear boundary that completes enclosure.
Watching and guarding supply the supervisory function of the later emplacement.

structural_cues: The exact verb root recurs in `يَسْلُكْهُ` at 72:17 and `يَسْلُكُ` at 72:27; the latter is expanded by explicit front-and-back spatial coordinates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition plus a bounded guarded arrangement; I infer a shared administrative-routing logic and contrast the two destinations. A live alternative is that `سلك` is ordinary causative entry in both places without a deliberate corridor correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The focus verb is only an idiom for causing someone to suffer.
changed_reading.after: The focus depicts controlled routing into a punitive corridor, contrasted with controlled guarding of a messenger's transmission corridor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing frame combines disclosure to knowledge, complete cognitive enclosure, exhaustive counting, totality, and enumeration. Read back onto the focus, the arduous punishment is not uncontrolled overwhelm; it is a routed consequence held within lordly administration and exact account.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the administrator to whom the reminder and consequence belong.
Deliberate insertion supplies the administratively assigned route rather than random affliction.
A matter becoming disclosed to the knower supplies the closing epistemic purpose.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and secure possession supplies bounded oversight.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies exactness rather than diffuse severity.
Total enclosure and completion supply the comprehensive scope of the account.
Counting what is countable supplies itemized measure at the surah's close.

structural_cues: The final `لِيَعْلَمَ` purpose clause answers the focus's `لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ` purpose shape, and 72:28 repeats the Lord relation while closing with comprehensive account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosing knowledge and exhaustive enumeration; I infer that these qualify the focus's routing as measured administration. The live alternative is that the closing account concerns only protected message delivery and does not characterize individual punishment.

changed_reading.before: Arduous punishment is an image of unbounded escalating distress.
changed_reading.after: Its difficulty remains, but the route is bounded, supervised, and exactly accounted within lordly administration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary punishment branch is nearer than the root's withholding-and-weaning branch. It remains anchored in focus `عَذَابًا` and in the immediately preceding furnished water, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch-activated material analogy, not as an etymological replacement for punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `فِيهِ ... عَذَابًا` after the immediately preceding act of giving copious water.

activation_trace.role: Prosperity as ordeal makes supplied abundance capable of reversing from benefit to test.
Withholding and weaning away supply a deprivation image inside the punishment root.
Deliberately furnishing drink supplies what may later be withheld after the assay.
Water itself supplies the concrete substance around which provision and deprivation can reverse.
Copious water and provision sharpen the severity of a possible withdrawal image.

changed_reading.before: Water is the test benefit, while punishment is an unrelated later infliction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same abundance that assays may become the object of weaning or withdrawal when the subject turns away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain metallurgical reading is surprising because it joins distant fire branches around the standard punishment sense. It remains focus-only and visibly anchored in `نَفْتِنَ`, `عَذَابًا`, and `صَعَدًا`; downstream prose should call it an imagistic continuity, not claim that all three words literally denote one refining process.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The material sequence from `نَفْتِنَهُمْ` through insertion into `عَذَابًا صَعَدًا`.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal by trial supplies the process frame in which hidden quality is exposed.
Burning and fire-blackening supply the heat that can continue an assay beyond initial disclosure.
Torment and severe pain keep the activated heat image within the focus's punitive anchor.
Fire-rendering that changes color or taste supplies transformation under heat at the punishment's qualifier.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, punishment continues the assay under transformative heat: what abundance disclosed is then subjected to a harsher material process.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is especially surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant `ر ب و` mapping under focus root `ر ب ب`. The split inventory formally anchors the breath-swelling image and `صَعَدًا` independently supplies rising breath, but downstream prose must mark this as cross-branch bodily resonance and must never gloss `رَبّ` as panting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `رَبِّهِ ... صَعَدًا`, with the non-dominant mapped branch held beside the focus's explicit ascent qualifier.

activation_trace.role: Panting or breath-swelling from the packet's non-dominant mapped root supplies internal bodily pressure without redefining `رَبّ`.
Insertion into a state supplies the transition from relational refusal to embodied pressure.
A long pained breath rising from the chest supplies an internal somatic rendering of arduous ascent.

changed_reading.before: The ascent is external terrain or an abstract increase in hardship.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, ascent is also felt inwardly as breath that swells and rises under chest-burden after the break in lordly orientation.

strongest_changes: The immediate straight-route and abundant-water sequence makes provision the medium of assay rather than an uncomplicated reward.
The hearing-guidance-trust sequence turns remembrance into a reception circuit whose reversal exposes the subject to burden.
The repeated `س ل ك` in 72:27 reframes punishment as controlled routing and sets it against a guarded transmission corridor.
The final encompassing and counting frame qualifies arduous punishment as exact administration rather than chaos.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the focus a hinge between abundance, orientation, and routing: branch images exposed prosperity as assay, differentiated paths as sorted trajectories, and two sharply opposed forms of managed emplacement. The split `ر ب ب` mapping also preserved a contained bodily breath resonance that a dominant-root-only reading would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether `فِيهِ` points narrowly to copious water, broadly to provision, or to the entire condition of straightness.
Whether the repeated `س ل ك` supports a deliberate two-corridor architecture or only ordinary lexical reuse.
Whether the water-withdrawal, metallurgical heat, and breath-swelling outliers should influence prose beyond explicitly qualified imagery.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Abundance becomes assay medium.** `لنفتنهم` activates ف ت ن B001, assaying by trial, with B004’s ordeal; `فيه` structurally points back to the abundant water; `ذكر` activates ذ ك ر B003/B009, bringing to mind and admonition. The supplied relation is water followed by testing “in it”; the inferred arrow is that provision reveals the recipient’s material through use and response. The ayah therefore corrects 72:16: abundance is diagnostic, not self-validating.

2. **Turning sideways from reminder leads into an imposed ascent.** `يعرض` activates ع ر ض B005, turning one’s side away, and B004, interception across a way; `يسلكه` activates س ل ك B002, causing entry; `عذابا` activates ع ذ ب B005, punishment, with B003’s withholding; `صعدا` activates ص ع د B003, arduous uphill hardship. The sequence reverses the prior straight path: voluntary lateral turning is answered by being made to enter a steep course. The inferred causal geometry is correction through constrained movement. Punishment reads as an escalating, withholding passage rather than a static condition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The paired deviation roots in 72:22 (`يجيرني/ملتحدا`, ج و ر B001 and ل ح د B001) strengthen the side-turning geometry. Conversely, guarded `يسلك` in 72:27 shows that caused entry can protect a sound channel as well as impose a hard ascent.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Water performs the assay usually imaged by fire.** Fixed `ف ت ن` B001 is assaying metal to distinguish quality, including testing by fire; B004 explicitly includes prosperity as a trial. The pronoun `فِيهِ` returns to abundant water (72:16), while 72:15 has just supplied firewood. The packet supplies fire-assay imagery, actual plenitude, and purpose; I infer that opposite material conditions can perform the same diagnostic function. `لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ` reads as abundance revealing composition as effectively as adversity.

2. **Turning away is a sideways failure of straightness.** Fixed `ع ر ض` B005 is presenting one's side and refusing attention; B012 is sidewise, unsteady movement that fails to go straight. It immediately follows `ٱسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَة` and precedes compulsory `س ل ك` routing. The packet supplies upright path, lateral turn, and subsequent route; I infer that neglect begins as a change of orientation before it becomes a new destination. `يُعْرِضْ` reads as embodied de-alignment.

3. **Remembrance keeps the formative relation present.** Fixed `ذ ك ر` B003 is bringing something to mind and retaining it; B004 is voiced mention and B009 a reminder. Its construct `ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ` anchors it to `ر ب ب` B002, stage-by-stage nurture. The local sequence includes prostration sites, calling, and the servant's standing in 72:18-20, supplying bodily and verbal modes of maintained attention. The packet supplies inward recall, outward mention, and formative lordship; I infer that remembrance keeps provision attached to its source and purpose. Turning away therefore severs the interpretive relation that lets abundance remain guidance.

4. **The one who leaves one route is inserted into another.** Fixed `س ل ك` B001 is proceeding through a path and B002 is causing someone to enter a place, state, or punishment. The transitive `يَسْلُكْهُ` follows the subject's own lateral turn; fixed `ع ذ ب` B005 names torment, and fixed `ص ع د` B003 names an arduous uphill pass. The packet supplies self-initiated reorientation and causative insertion; I infer a directional handoff: choosing to turn from remembrance results in being routed through a harsher system. The ending reads as path conversion, not a disconnected penalty.

5. **Sweet-water and punishment branches form a material reversal.** Fixed `ع ذ ب` B001 is fresh, sweet, palatable water, while the actual surface `عَذَابًا` activates B005 punishment. Coming directly after `مَاءً غَدَقًا`, the shared root inventory makes palatability and pain adjacent. The packet supplies abundant water, testing, and the two `ع ذ ب` poles; I infer that a provision detached from remembrance can reverse in experienced function. The punishment reading remains primary, but it now carries the latent image of sweetness withheld or spoiled.

6. **The punishment is self-steepening.** Fixed `ص ع د` B001 is upward ascent, B003 an arduous uphill hardship, and B008 upward increase. Earlier the group abandoned escape as viable (72:12); now the imposed route becomes harder as it rises. The packet supplies no escape and increasing slope; I infer that effort does not move the traveler out of the system but deeper into its difficulty. `عَذَابًا صَعَدًا` reads as escalating resistance rather than a static quantity of pain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:27 reactivates fixed `س ل ك` B002 by inserting prepared guards before and behind an approved messenger. The root therefore does not itself select punishment: in this fixed ayah it routes the one who turns away into hardship, while later it routes protection around faithful carriage. Also, 72:22's failed search for `مُلْتَحَدًا` confirms that neither the rising route nor its source can be escaped by finding a side junction.

baseline.text: Bununla onları sınamak için. Kim Rabbinin anılmasından yüz çevirirse O, onu çetin bir azaba sokar.

findings.text: Sınama, ateşle yapılan maden ayırma imgesini bolluk suyuna taşır; refah da sıkıntı kadar kişinin niteliğini ortaya çıkarabilir.
Yüz çevirmek, önceki dosdoğru duruşun karşısında yana dönerek yönünü kaybetme biçiminde bedensel ve mekânsal bir sapmadır.
Rabbin anılması, bolluğu kaynağına ve yetiştirici amacına bağlı tutar; ondan yüz çevirmek nimetin nasıl okunacağını da bozar.
Kişinin yana dönmesiyle başlayan hareket, onun başka ve daha çetin bir yola zorla sokulmasıyla sonuçlanır; ceza durağan bir durum değil, yön değiştiren bir geçittir.
Tatlı su çağrışımı ile ceza anlamının aynı kökte yakınlaşması, kaynağından koparılan bolluğun yaşanan işlev bakımından acıya dönüşebileceğini düşündürür.
Yokuş, çıkıldıkça direnci artan bir ceza süreci oluşturur; harcanan çaba çıkışa değil, güçlüğün derinleşmesine götürür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Route Mechanics Carry Water or Insert the Deflector into Punishment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Alignment with a route permits sustaining flow, whereas turning a side to the route changes the same conduit into a forced passage toward increasing difficulty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Reward and punishment are not two unrelated destinations; both are hydraulic or conduit operations performed on a body in relation to one route.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Abundance itself becomes an assay medium
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The supplied water is not only consumed; it becomes the medium in which recipients are tested and differentiated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: testing metal by fire and a person by trial (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); ordeal and affliction (`quranic:root_001128:B004/m01`); abundant water and provision (`quranic:root_001075:B001/m01`); making water continuously available (`quranic:root_000722:B002/m01`); increase and saturation with water (`quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`); gradual nurture to completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The trial is structurally joined to abundance: water supplies the surrounding medium in which conduct is exposed, much as fire reveals the quality of metal. Nurture and assay therefore coexist; plentiful provision can complete a subject or disclose its composition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Route Mechanics Carry Water or Insert the Deflector into Punishment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Alignment with a route permits sustaining flow, whereas turning a side to the route changes the same conduit into a forced passage toward increasing difficulty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Reward and punishment are not two unrelated destinations; both are hydraulic or conduit operations performed on a body in relation to one route.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Side-turning is threaded into a rising constriction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject presents its side and blocks the offered orientation, is inserted into a narrow passage, and experiences punishment as a steep ascent and labored breath.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: turning away by presenting one's side (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`); interception and blockage (`quranic:root_001001:B004/m01`); indirect or two-faced expression (`quranic:root_001001:B010/m01`); remembered content held in the heart (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); spoken remembrance (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); a reminder that restores presence (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); entering and traversing a path (`quranic:root_000735:B001/m01`); inserting one thing into another (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); straight penetrating thrust (`quranic:root_000735:B003/m01`); thread drawn through material (`quranic:root_000735:B004/m01`); an extended border in cloth (`quranic:root_000735:B005/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); coercive prevention (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); ascent (`quranic:root_000862:B001/m01`); steep obstacle and hardship (`quranic:root_000862:B003/m01`); rising painful breath (`quranic:root_000862:B007/m01`); transformation by heat (`quranic:root_000862:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The side-turn is a bodily refusal of alignment. Insertion then reverses agency: the one who would not enter the route is passed through it like thread or a straight thrust through resistant material. As the passage rises, hardship becomes respiratory and thermal, making "ascending punishment" a constricting process rather than a static place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Punishment Becomes Transformed Material and Fixed Residence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Disobedience passes through an afflictive transformation and terminates in an attached, enduring state from which ordinary movement or change is suspended.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Fire is both an assay and a material-processing operation, while eternity is rendered as adhesion, residence, and an event whose trace cannot disappear.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Trial becomes a furnace that alters its subject
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A subject is tested, inserted into painful heat, and changed as material is assayed, blackened, melted, or otherwise transformed by fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: assay of metal and person (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); burning and blackening (`quranic:root_001128:B002/m01`); ordeal and affliction (`quranic:root_001128:B004/m01`); conflict generated by trial (`quranic:root_001128:B006/m01`); painful punishment (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); insertion into a medium (`quranic:root_000735:B002/m01`); transformation under heat (`quranic:root_000862:B009/m01`); light and illumination (`quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`); smoke pigment used as a lasting mark (`quranic:root_001564:B008/m01`); disobedient departure from command (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The furnace does not merely surround its subject; it tests composition and produces visible change. Blackening, melting, illumination, and marking are distinct outcomes of one thermal process. Disobedience supplies the movement out of command, while forced insertion returns the subject to a medium that exposes and fixes what it is.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sınama ve deneme çekirdeğini açıkça verir; insanın sınanmasını ve madenin ateşte işlenerek iyisinin kötüsünden ayrılmasını aynı nitelik belirleme sürecinin iki uygulaması olarak gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalnızca yakmak bu dalı karşılamaz; ateşle işlem, madenin niteliğini ortaya çıkaran bir sınama olduğunda bu dala girer.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem genel sınama biçimlerini hem de madenin ateşte sınanmasına bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımları içerir; maden özeli bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi ya da şeyi sınayarak gerçek durumunu veya niteliğini ortaya çıkarmaktır; bunun özel bir uygulamasında altın ya da gümüş ateşte işlenip iyisi kötüsünden ayrılır.

facets.statement: Sınama, denenen kimsenin ya da şeyin gerçek durumunu ve niteliğini görünür kılar.
Altın ve gümüşün ateşte eritilmesi, iyi kısmı kötü kısımdan ayıran özel bir sınama yoludur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sınama ve deneme anlamında birleşir; madenin ateşe sokulmasını da sırf yakma olarak değil, kalitesini ortaya çıkarıp iyi ile kötüyü ayıran bir işlem olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan sınamasını ve madenin ateşte niteliğinin belirlenmesini ortak çekirdekte ifade eden en kapsamlı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınama işlemini ve bu işlemle gerçek niteliğin ortaya çıkmasını birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Genel deneme ve gerçek durumu ortaya çıkarma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Madenin ateşte işlenip iyisinin kötüsünden ayrılması özelini tek başına taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Altın veya gümüşün ateşte işlenerek kalitesinin belirlenmesi ve iyi kısmının kötüden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Ateşle yapılan maden sınamasını ve nitelik ayrımını eksiksiz korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل في هذا الإحراق بالنار، وإدخال الشيء أو الإنسان النار، والعذاب بالنار، وما صار أسود أو متغيرا بالنار كالحرة الفتين

branches.source_phrase_ar: الفتن الإحراق، وشيء فتين أي محرق، ويقال للحرة فتين (maqayis); على النار يفتنون أي يحرقون، وحرة فتين إذا كانت سوداء (jamhara); الفتن الإحراق، وورق فتبن أي فضة محرقة، ويقال للحرة فتين (sihah); يفتنون أي يحرقون بالنار، الفتن الإحراق، كل ما غيرته النار عن حاله فهو مفتون (tahdhib); استعمل في إدخال الإنسان النار، يوم هم على النار يفتنون (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi birini doğru yönden veya benimsediği görüşten uzaklaştırma çekirdeğini açıkça verir; arzu yoluyla baştan çıkarma ve kötülüğü çekici gösterme bu yön değiştirmenin özel yollarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kişinin kendiliğinden yolunu kaybetmesinden çok, bir etkenin onu yönünden döndürmesi ve saptırması öne çıkar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın saptırma biçimleri ile görüşten döndürme, arzuya çekme ve belirli yapılara bağlı kullanımlar ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi doğru yönden, amacından veya benimsediği görüşten uzaklaştırıp başka bir yöne çekmektir; aldatma, arzuyu kışkırtma ve kötülüğü çekici gösterme bunun özel yollarıdır.

facets.statement: Etken bir kişi veya güç, başkasını doğru yönden ya da mevcut görüşünden uzaklaştırır.
Arzu yoluyla baştan çıkarma, aldatma ve kötülüğü çekici gösterme saptırmanın özel gerçekleşme biçimleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönden saptırma ve kişiyi bulunduğu görüşten uzaklaştırma anlamında birleşir; baştan çıkaran kişi ile kötülüğü aldatıcı biçimde süsleyen şeytanı bu etkinin belirgin örnekleri sayar.

concept_gloss.text: doğru yoldan saptırma ve baştan çıkarma
concept_gloss.applicability: Yönünden döndürme çekirdeğini ve aldatma ya da arzu yoluyla baştan çıkarma özelini birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasını yönünden uzaklaştırma ile çekici göstererek ayartma yollarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birini doğru yoldan, amacından veya benimsediği görüşten uzaklaştırma bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir etkenin başkasının yönünü değiştirmesi çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Arzu, aldatma ve kötülüğü çekici gösterme yoluyla baştan çıkarma özelini belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Arzu uyandırma, aldatma veya kötülüğü çekici gösterme yoluyla birini yanlış davranışa çekme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayartma ve çekici göstererek yanlış yöne çekme biçimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Birini görüşünden döndürmenin arzu içermeyen daha geniş kapsamını taşımaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanları aldatan ve kötülüğü çekici gösteren şeytan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, bir etkenin başkasını saptırmasını ve aldatma ya da arzu yoluyla baştan çıkarmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kişinin doğru yolu bırakıp yanlışta veya yönsüzlükte bulunması durumunu da çekirdeğine alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da doğru yönün ve sağlıklı amacın bırakılmasıyla oluşan yanlış yönelimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çoğunlukla saptıran bir etken ile yönü değiştirilen kişiyi ayırır; komşu dal ise kişinin içinde bulunduğu sapmış durumu daha doğrudan adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Saptırma, eğilme, aldatma, kötülüğü süsleme ve kardeş dalların tümü değerlendirildi; etken saptırma ile sapmış durum ayrımını gösteren aday seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل في هذا الإضلال والإمالة عن القصد والإزالة عما كان عليه، وفتنة المرأة أو الشهوة، وفعل الشيطان أو الفتان الذي يخدع ويزين المعاصي
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الاختبار المحض ولا الإحراق بالنار
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفتان الشيطان (maqayis); الفاتن المضل عن الحق، وفتنته المرأة إذا دلهته (sihah); أمالته عن القصد، الفتينة المميلة عن الحق، فتنت الرجل عن رأيه أي أزلته، الفتنة الإضلال، الفتان الشيطان (tahdhib); ما أنتم عليه بفاتنين أي بمضلين، يفتنوك عن بعض ما أنزل الله إليك (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sıkıntı, bolluk ve cezanın kişiyi sınayan durumlar olabileceğini açıkça belirtir; mal ve çocuklar da sınamanın gerçekleştiği özel alanlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her güçlük bu dala girmez; durumun kişiyi sınaması veya ona yönelmiş bir ceza niteliği taşıması anlamın merkezindedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel sıkıntı ve sınanma kullanımı ile mal ve çocuklara bağlı kalıplaşmış sınanma kullanımı birbirine karıştırılmadan korunur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin sıkıntı veya bolluk içinde sınandığı durum ya da ona yönelmiş cezadır; mal ve çocuklar bu sınamanın gerçekleşebildiği özel alanlardır.

facets.statement: Sıkıntı da bolluk da kişiyi deneyen bir durum olarak işleyebilir.
Ceza anlamı ile mal ve çocuklar üzerinden sınanma, çekirdeğin belirli sonuç ve uygulama alanlarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu anlamı kişiye gelen sınama, sıkıntı ve ceza çevresinde kurar; sınamanın yalnız darlıkta değil bollukta da olabileceğini ve mal ile çocukların buna konu olabileceğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: kişiyi sınayan sıkıntı, bolluk veya ceza
concept_gloss.applicability: Sınayıcı durumu, bunun hem darlık hem bolluk biçimini ve ceza uzantısını birlikte kapsayan açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin ağır veya elverişli koşulla sınanmasını ve ceza anlamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişiye gelen ağır bir durumun onun dayanıklılığını veya tutumunu sınaması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkıntı yoluyla gerçekleşen sınanmayı açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Bollukla sınanmayı, ceza anlamını ve mal ile çocuklara bağlı özel kullanımı kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin sahip oldukları ve çocukları üzerinden denendiği özel bağlam için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mal ve çocukların sınama konusu olmasını eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Başka sıkıntı ve bolluk türlerini veya bağımsız ceza anlamını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bollukla sınanmayı, ceza anlamını ve mal ile çocukların sınama konusu olmasını ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sınamanın kişinin içindekini ve gönlündeki tutumu açığa çıkarmasını daha açık biçimde belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişiye gelen güçlük, onun durumunu ortaya çıkaran bir sınama işlevi görür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sınayıcı durumların tür ve alanlarını genişçe kapsar; komşu dal sınamanın iç durumu açığa çıkaran işlevine daha sıkı bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sıkıntı, felaket, ceza, sınama ve kardeş dal adaylarının tamamı değerlendirildi; bolluk ve ceza kapsamındaki farkı gösteren karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل في هذا البلية والمحنة والشدة والرخاء إذا كانا موضع اختبار، والعذاب، وما يبتلى به المرء في المال والأولاد
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإحراق الحسي وحده ولا القتل والحروب خاصة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفتنة المحنة، والفتنة المال، والفتنة الأولاد، والفتنة العذاب، وجماع الفتنة الابتلاء والامتحان (tahdhib); الفتنة كالبلاء، يستعملان فيما يدفع إليه الإنسان من شدة ورخاء، أي بليتهم وعذابهم، أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi inançsızlık, günah, karanlık yorumda aşırılık ve dünya kazancı peşinde ölçüyü aşmayı aynı dalda sıralar. Bunlar tek bir bağlamda birbirinin yerine geçen karşılıklar değildir; ancak ağır inanç ve davranış sapması üst sınırıyla birlikte tutulabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan hata veya genel sıkıntı anlamına genişletilmemeli; ağır inanç sapması, günah, yorum aşırılığı ve ölçüsüz dünya tutkusu ile sınırlı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimlerin verdiği ağır inanç ve davranış sapması alanıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnançta veya davranışta ağır bir sapma ve ölçüyü aşma durumudur; inançsızlık, günah, karanlık yorumda aşırılık ve dünya kazancına ölçüsüz bağlanma bu alanın ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: İnançsızlık, günah ve karanlık bir yorumda aşırılık ağır sapmanın ayrı görünümleridir.
Dünya kazancını ölçüsüz biçimde istemek, aynı aşırılık alanının davranışsal uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dal, ağır inanç sapması ve günah anlamlarını yorumda aşırılık ve dünya kazancına ölçüsüz düşkünlükle aynı kaynak kümesinde bir araya getirir.

source_details.summary: Bu anlam kümesi tek kaynak tanıklığına dayanır ve dört ayrı gerçekleşmeyi ortak aşırılık sınırı içinde sıralar.

concept_gloss.text: inançta veya davranışta ağır sapma ve aşırılık
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın farklı gerçekleşmelerini tek sözcükte özdeşleştirmeden ortak ağır sapma sınırında toplayan açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İnanç, davranış ve istek alanlarındaki ağır sapma ile ölçüyü aşmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnançsızlık, günah veya karanlık yorumda aşırılık türlerinden hangisinin kastedildiği bağlamdan anlaşıldığında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: İnanç ve davranış alanındaki ciddi yön kaybını korur.
error_profile.loses: Dünya kazancına ölçüsüz bağlanma uzantısını ve aşırılığın belirli türlerini açıkça saymaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin dünya kazancını istemede sınırı aşması anlatıldığında kullanılan özel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dünya kazancına yönelik ölçüsüz isteği açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: İnançsızlık, günah ve yorumda aşırılık görünümlerini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: inançsızlık, günah veya karanlık yorumda aşırılık

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal inançsızlık, günah, karanlık yorumda aşırılık ve dünya kazancına ölçüsüz bağlanma gibi belirli yorumları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yanlışta kaybolmayı, bilgisizliği ve doğru yolun karşıtı olan daha genel yönsüzlüğü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da doğru ve ölçülü olandan uzaklaşıp yanlışta bulunma alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli inanç ve davranış yargılarına bağlı ağır sapmaları toplar; komşu dal ise doğru yönün karşıtı olan genel sapmış durumu anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: İnanç sapması, günah, yorum aşırılığı, karşıt değerler ve kardeş dalların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel sapma ile belirli ağır yargılar arasındaki sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل في هذا الكفر والإثم والغلو في التأويل المظلم وطلب الدنيا إذا غلب على صاحبه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد البلاء النازل بالمرء ولا الإحراق الحسي
branches.source_phrase_ar: الفتنة ههنا الكفر، والفتنة الإثم، والفتنة الغلو في التأويل المظلم، فلان مفتون يطلب الدنيا

source_note.TA: Bu anlam kümesi tek kaynak tanıklığına dayanır ve dört ayrı gerçekleşmeyi ortak aşırılık sınırı içinde sıralar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi öldürme, savaş ve insanlar arasındaki ayrılığı doğrudan aynı kullanım alanında verir; özellikle Müslüman topluluklar arasında çıkan çatışmayı belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her görüş ayrılığı bu dala girmez; öldürmeye, savaşa veya toplumsal bölünmeye dönüşen ağır çatışma sınırı korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimlerin öldürme, savaş ve toplumsal çatışma anlamını verir; başka dallardaki sınama veya sıkıntı anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Öldürme, savaş ve insanlar arasında ağır ayrılık doğuran çatışmadır; kullanım özellikle Müslüman topluluklar arasında çıkan savaş ve bölünmeleri kapsar.

facets.statement: Öldürme ve savaş, dalın şiddet içeren temel alanını oluşturur.
İnsanlar ve özellikle Müslüman topluluklar arasındaki ağır ayrılık, savaş alanının toplumsal görünümüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak tanıklığı, sözcüğü doğrudan öldürme için kullanır ve anlam alanını savaşlar ile özellikle Müslüman topluluklar arasındaki ağır ayrılıklara genişletir.

source_details.summary: Bu öldürme, savaş ve toplumsal ayrılık kümesi tek kaynak tanıklığıyla aktarılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bireysel öldürmeyi, savaş durumunu ve topluluklar arasındaki ağır bölünmeyi birlikte kapsayan karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Öldürme, örgütlü çatışma ve toplumsal ayrışma alanlarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluklar arasında savaş, bölünme ve karşılıklı şiddet çıktığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Savaş ve toplumsal çatışma alanını açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Bağımsız olarak kullanılan öldürmek fiilini ve tekil öldürme eylemini bütünüyle kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin doğrudan birilerini öldürme anlamında kullanıldığı dar bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Doğrudan can alma eylemini eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Savaş, toplumsal bölünme ve gruplar arası çatışma kapsamını taşımaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: öldürme, savaş ve insanlar arasındaki ağır ayrılık

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal öldürmeyi ve özellikle Müslüman topluluklar arasındaki ağır ayrılığı doğrudan anlam alanına alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal savaşın karşıtı olan barışla kurduğu ekseni, düşmanlığı ve savaşla ilgili yer veya kişi adlandırmalarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeğinde savaş ve insanlar arasındaki şiddetli karşıtlık bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öldürme ile topluluk içi bölünmeyi aynı çatışma alanında toplar; komşu dal genel savaş ve düşmanlık söz varlığına daha geniş biçimde yayılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Savaş, ayrılık, topluluğun dağılması, şiddetin alevlenmesi ve kardeş dalların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel savaş alanıyla sınırı en açık aday seçildi.

source_note.TA: Bu öldürme, savaş ve toplumsal ayrılık kümesi tek kaynak tanıklığıyla aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin başına gelen yıkıcı bir durum yüzünden malını veya aklını yitirmesini açıkça verir; akıl yitimi ayrıca delilik adı olarak belirtilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalnızca baştan çıkarılmak bu dala girmez; mal veya akıl kaybı ya da iyi durumdan kötü duruma düşüş gibi yıkıcı sonuç gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal sonuç bildiren eylem biçimini ve gönle bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımı ayrı tutar; mal kaybı ile akıl kaybını tek sonuca indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin başına gelen yıkıcı bir durum sonucunda malını veya aklını yitirmesidir; akıl kaybı yerleşik bir delilik durumuna dönüşebilir.

facets.statement: Başına gelen yıkıcı durum, kişinin malını veya aklını kaybetmesine yol açar.
Akıl kaybının yerleşik sonucu delilik olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bir tanıklık, kişinin başına gelen yıkıcı bir durum sonucunda malını veya aklını yitirmesini verir; diğer tanıklık ise delilik durumunu ve delirmiş kişiyi ayrı anlamlar olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: sarsıntı yüzünden malını veya aklını yitirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yıkıcı nedeni, iki ayrı kayıp alanını ve akıl kaybının deliliğe varabilen sonucunu kapsayan açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yıkıcı olay ile mal veya akıl kaybı arasındaki sonuç ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başına gelen yıkıcı durum sonucunda kişinin akıl sağlığını yitirmesi veya delirmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl kaybını ve bunun deliliğe varan sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Malın yitirilmesi sonucunu ve iki sonuç arasındaki seçeneği kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yıkıcı bir olayın kişinin malını götürdüğü bağlamda doğal bir metin içi karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin mal kaybına uğraması sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Akıl kaybını ve delilik sonucunu kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: başına gelen sarsıntıyla malını veya aklını yitirmek; iyi durumdan kötüye düşmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yıkıcı bir olay sonucundaki mal kaybını ve iyi durumdan kötüye düşüşü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal akıl kaybının yanında deli görünme veya deliliği dışa vurma biçimlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da aklın sağlıklı işleyişini yitirmesi ve delilik durumunda belirgin biçimde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal akıl kaybını mal kaybıyla birlikte yıkıcı bir olayın sonucu olarak kurar; komşu dal doğrudan delilik durumuna ve onun görünüşlerine odaklanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Akıl kaybı, delilik, mal kaybı, yıkım ve kardeş dalların tamamı karşılaştırıldı; iki sonuçlu odak ile yalnız akıl durumuna yönelen adayın farkı yayımlandı.
